finalCta.heading: Start with the basics.
finalCta.body: Share the location, the work you need, and your preferred timing. We will follow up with practical next steps.

services.heading: Work that solves the actual problem.
services.intro: Iron Ridge Services handles focused repairs, exterior improvements, landscape installation, custom fabrication, and recurring property needs. Every project starts with a clear scope.
services.ctaHeading: Not sure where your project fits?
services.ctaBody: Describe the issue and the outcome you need. We can sort out the right service category from there.

projects.heading: Practical scopes. Durable materials.
projects.intro: Use this page to show finished work with concise scope notes, relevant locations, and clear photographs. The current entries are editable examples only.
projects.ctaBody: Send the property location and a short description. Photos, rough dimensions, and timing are useful when available.

about.heading: One accountable point of contact.
about.intro: Iron Ridge Services is presented as a practical, owner-operated contracting business serving residential and small commercial properties across the Salt Lake City area.
storyBody: Good service starts before the tools come out. It means listening to the problem, looking closely at the site, and being direct about scope, timing, and constraints.
During the work, communication stays simple. You know who is responsible, what is happening next, and where a decision is needed.
This temporary website copy is ready for the owner to replace with a real background, specialty, and working approach. It makes no claims about years, licenses, awards, or past clients.

principles.title: Plan the details
principles.body: Measure carefully, confirm access, and identify constraints before they become delays.

principles.title: Communicate directly
principles.body: Keep updates useful, raise issues early, and make next steps easy to understand.

principles.title: Leave it right
principles.body: Finish the small details, clean the work area, and walk through the result.

about.ctaBody: Tell us what is happening at the property and what a good result looks like.

contact.heading: Tell us what needs to be done.
contact.intro: A short, useful description is enough to start. Include the project location, timing, and any access or site conditions we should know about.
